summary: Missing-person search in the Sandbeach Lake/Wild Basin area after an individual "willingly walked away" from family at the Wild Basin entrance; seen Apr 30 near Copeland Lake and May 1 near the summer trailhead; multi-day search suspended May 5, investigation ongoing; April-2024 follow-up: the individual resurfaced and was arrested in Teller County on fraud/theft charges (former El Paso County sheriff's deputy).
location: Sandbeach Lake / Wild Basin, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Criminal/profile detail omitted per policy; outcome "assist" (search conducted, individual resurfaced on own later).
